Diego / team / Sarah — attaching the runbook and allowlist template as requested. Short summary below and next steps.

Attachments: redwood-poc-runbook.pdf, staging-allowlist-template.csv

Runbook highlights:
- Sandbox provisioning: we will create a temporary sandbox API key (read/write limited) tied to the Infill Health org. Key lifetime: 14 days (revoke anytime).
- Staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/projects/infill-38491 (internal staging path; will be accessible once allowlist applied)
- Header example: Authorization: Bearer <sandbox-key>
- IP allowlist template: fill column "ip_address" in attached CSV and email back to devops@infillhealth.com or upload to your ticketing system
- Troubleshooting: 403 -> check header/key scope; 504 -> check routing and sequence length; if KV cache mismatch, restart session

Load sanity proposal (Ben):
- Tool: small locust script (attached in Drive)
- Burst: 50 concurrent connections for 5 minutes targeting ~1500 tokens/sec aggregated
- Token limit per request: 512 tokens
- Safety: well throttle if latency > 500ms P90 during the burst

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-infill-poc
Calendar invite draft: "Redwood × Infill — Technical Kickstart (hands-on) — Mon 2026-06-28 10:00 PT | 90m"
